link.text:
#!/bin/sh
printf 'link' >> "$LOG"
for a in "$@"; do printf ' <%s>' "$a" >> "$LOG"; done
printf '\n' >> "$LOG"
printf 'link stdout\n'
printf 'link stderr\n' >&2
for a in "$@"; do
  case $a in
    /MANIFESTFILE:*)
      printf 'intermediate manifest\n' > "${a#/MANIFESTFILE:}"
      ;;
  esac
done
exit "${LINK_EXIT:-0}"

mt.text:
#!/bin/sh
printf 'mt' >> "$LOG"
for a in "$@"; do printf ' <%s>' "$a" >> "$LOG"; done
printf '\n' >> "$LOG"
printf 'mt stdout\n'
printf 'mt stderr\n' >&2
notify=0
for a in "$@"; do
  case $a in
    /notify_update)
      notify=1
      ;;
    /out:*)
      printf 'mt manifest\n' > "${a#/out:}"
      ;;
  esac
done
if [ "$notify" = 1 ]; then
  exit "${MT_NOTIFY_EXIT:-0}"
fi
exit "${MT_EXIT:-0}"

rc.text:
#!/bin/sh
printf 'rc' >> "$LOG"
for a in "$@"; do printf ' <%s>' "$a" >> "$LOG"; done
printf '\n' >> "$LOG"
printf 'Resource Compiler Version fake\n'
printf 'rc output\n'
out=
while [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; do
  if [ "$1" = /fo ]; then
    shift
    out=$1
  fi
  shift
done
if [ -n "$out" ]; then
  printf 'resource\n' > "$out"
fi
exit "${RC_EXIT:-0}"
